cues.text: So I was going to tell you about the trip.
We got up early and went to the station.
Did you ever try to catch a train at six?
It was a lot harder than I thought it would be.
My friend bought a coffee and spilled it.
We had to wait for about twenty minutes.
Then the train finally showed up.
I gotta say, the view was amazing.
We saw mountains, lakes, and little towns.
What do you want to do when we get there?
That is what she asked me on the way.
I said I wanted to eat something first.
We found a little place next to the river.
The food was better than I expected.
After lunch we walked around the old town.
It started to rain, so we went into a museum.
I could have stayed there all day.
We took the last train back home.
Honestly, it was one of the best days ever.
I would totally do it again next year.
